purpose: Admit and immutably ingest the third-slot React candidate for board task T006: the portfolio's first create-react-app 5 / webpack 5 cell and its first npm package-lock cell, with an upstream-authored end-to-end suite and no backend.

upstream.pinnedCommitRelationshipToTag: direct child of the tag target; the two trees differ in exactly one blob, reviewpad.yml (a CI bot config). See tag-delta.json.
upstream.commitVerification: GitHub reports verification.verified=true, reason 'valid' — the commit is signed

archive.singleRootNote: codeload names the archive root from the repository's CURRENT name, so the root says BioDrop even though the revision predates the rename.

reconciliation.method: every extracted regular file was hashed as a git blob object and compared against the recursive tree at the pinned revision

redirectHandling.why: The packet names the repository by a name that no longer exists upstream, so a redirect was expected and the usual no-redirect policy could not simply be applied.
redirectHandling.policy: Redirects were not silently followed. Each hop was written to probe-ledger.ndjson with its status and Location; at most two hops per request were permitted; and a hop whose target host was neither api.github.com nor codeload.github.com would have aborted the transaction.
redirectHandling.observed: Exactly one redirect: 301 from https://api.github.com/repos/EddieHubCommunity/LinkFree to https://api.github.com/repositories/405139301. Every subsequent request was issued directly against the canonical name and answered 200 with no further hop.

chain.why: The probe revealed that the pinned commit is not the tag target. This step establishes the discrepancy in bytes — a blob-level diff of the two trees — rather than describing it.

A re-run of the SAME declared pipeline split at the npm lifecycle boundary, so the postbuild purge could be stated in bytes. No command was changed; only a stat was taken between `react-scripts build` and `npm run postbuild`.

written: Six driver scripts under evidence/ingests/react-linkfree-v0-72-0/drivers/. They are working tools, not evidence: the network-touching ones refuse to run unless VERSIONLESS_NETWORK_MODE=consented and VERSIONLESS_CONSENT_ID matches, each writes only into this evidence directory and the git-ignored cache, and together they make this ingest re-runnable end to end.
reused: The evidence shape established by evidence/ingests/react-memos-v0-1-3/ and its predecessors: attempt/source documents, a per-response ledger with byte count and digest, blob-level archive-to-git-tree parity, declared-cell honesty, and non-claim discipline.

A Node 16.20.2 darwin-arm64 runtime already acquired and digest-verified against the official nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt by an earlier ingest in this workspace; it was copied into this unit's baseline cell and no new runtime download was made.
notWritten: No module, driver, or script was added under packages/**, scripts/**, or docs/**; the packet places them out of contract.
No core enum or fixture-id union was edited. Serialization of this fixture into the workspace's closed fixture-id union belongs to the serial phase, not to this unit.

dataHandling.concern: public/data holds 561 profile JSON files, each NAMED by a real contributor's GitHub username.
dataHandling.rule: Treated as application content addressed by digest. Counted, aggregate-digested, and characterised by host histograms only. No individual username, data filename, display name, bio, or link value appears in any record this unit produced.
dataHandling.verification: The drivers that touch the corpus (03-inventory.mjs) emit only counts, histograms and an aggregate digest by construction; no per-file name or field value reaches an evidence record.

cache.note: Cache trees are git-ignored and ephemeral; the durable record is this evidence directory plus fixtures/react-linkfree-v0-72-0/fixture.json.

nonclaims: Byte-identical duplicate fetches and blob-level git-tree parity establish source integrity for this revision only. The commit's signature is reported valid by GitHub, but this unit did not verify it against a key it trusts, and the annotated tag is unsigned and in any case does not point at the pinned commit.
A green install and a green declared build establish that this source compiles in this cell. No browser was driven and the upstream cypress suite was not run.
This provenance record establishes no migration feasibility, pilot status, production readiness, certification, or legal approval.
